feeds.title: The Anaesthesia Consultant
feeds.description: Richard Novak, MD is a Stanford physician board-certified in anesthesiology and internal medicine. Dr. Novak is an Adjunct Clinical Associate Professor in the Department of Anesthesiology, Perioperative and Pain Medicine at Stanford University, the Medical Director at Waverley Surgery Center in Palo Alto, California, and a member of the Associated Anesthesiologists Medical Group in California.

feeds.title: Case Reports in Anesthesia
feeds.description: Blog with interesting cases and/or problems related to anesthesia with discussion based on best evidence in the literature.

feeds.title: Somnia Blog
feeds.description: Somnia is a full-service clinical anesthesia management company, founded in 1996 by practicing anesthesiologists. The company began by providing high-quality anesthesia services to hospitals, surgery centers, and office-based surgical facilities.

feeds.title: Radius Anesthesia Blog
feeds.description: Radius Anesthesia Services PLLC was founded by an anesthesiologist with the objective of providing exceptional anesthesia care and peri-operative services to the patients of the Greater New York City area. We offer a comprehensive approach to anesthesia services that starts with exceptional recruiting. Our anesthesiologists are experienced, board-certified and have impeccable bedside manners.

feeds.title: Anaesthesia News
feeds.description: Covers articles about history of anesthesia, clinical anesthesia, obstetric, regional anesthesia, anesthesia secrets and more by Dr. J.Edward Johnson.

feeds.title: The Anaesthesia Collective Blog
feeds.description: It has easy-to-follow courses, videos, and podcasts that explain how to do things like give anaesthesia, insert IV lines, manage pain, and keep patients safe during surgery. The blog shares practical tips, explains medical techniques in clear language, and helps both beginners and experienced doctors prepare for exams.

feeds.title: AAS Blogs
feeds.description: Explore the latest insights and updates. Stay informed with AAS blogs for trends in anesthesiology, mobile anesthesia, healthcare, and more.

feeds.title: CCI Anesthesia Blog
feeds.description: Read our Anesthesia Management blog to follow the latest changes affecting the anesthesia industry.

feeds.title: Anesthesia Experts Blog
feeds.description: This one is a comprehensive educational resource for anesthesia trainees. It covers everything from technique tutorials and physiology basics to surgical case discussions and exam revision materials.

feeds.title: NovaSed Blog
feeds.description: Stay informed about trends in the sedation industry, anesthesia types, patient safety, regulatory requirements, and more. Start exploring today!

feeds.title: EMOttawa Blog » Anesthesiology
feeds.description: EMOttawa is the official blog for the Department of Emergency Medicine at the University of Ottawa. Their mission is to provide outstanding compassionate emergency care through practice-changing research and innovative medical education.

feeds.title: GomerBlog » Anesthesiology
feeds.description: GomerBlog is dedicated to bringing you funny medical satire for Healthcare Professionals. Many are already calling us 'The Onion' for doctors, nurses, and all health care professionals. Our goal is to provide comic relief to our hard working healthcare professionals. Working in medicine is tough and we all need some relief.

feeds.title: RK.md
feeds.description: Harvard combined clinical fellow in critical care and adult cardiothoracic anesthesiology looking to improve medical education, diagnostics, and patient safety while promoting team-based, patient-centered care.

feeds.title: Nurse Jess CRNA Blog
feeds.description: My name is Jessica. I'm currently a certified registered nurse anesthetist and I'm writing this blog to give my readers insight into nurse anesthesia and nursing as a profession.

feeds.title: Dr. Nikesh Seth
feeds.description: Nikesh Seth MD Hi, I am Nikesh Seth, MD CEO of Integrated Pain Consultants. I will be posting weekly about new topics ranging from managing pain to the current Opioid epidemic. I am double board certified Anesthesiologist that is consistently awarded 'Top Doc' in the field of pain management by Phoenix Magazine.

feeds.title: Graphium Health Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles specifically for anesthesia practices and anesthesia providers with topics that come from experts all over the world of anesthesiology. From Practicing Anesthesiologists & CRNAs to billing experts & CPAs, Graphium's aim is to modernize and empower your anesthesia practice.

feeds.title: EdMariano.com
feeds.description: Edward R. Mariano, MD, is a physician anesthesiologist, husband, and father working to improve pain control, outcomes, and the overall experience for patients having surgery.

feeds.title: Amanda Xi
feeds.description: I am a Massachusetts General Hospital Anesthesiology resident, a former Henry Ford Hospital Transitional Year resident, an MD graduate of OUWB, active leader in AMWA, sometimes graphic designer and lover of all things technology.

feeds.title: Behind The Drapes
feeds.description: This blog site has been long in the making since I started anesthesia school. I remember I googled and found a few blogs sites before and during I was in school where the bloggers shared their experiences as nurse anesthesia students. It was great to learn how other fellow students went through as they were on this career path.

feeds.title: Rapid Sequence Blog
feeds.description: Rapid Sequence was set up to act as an on-line journal club that can be accessed whenever is most convenient. It's purpose is purely to be a source of useful and interesting information on the topics of anaesthesia and critical care medicine. This may be through reviews of guidelines, evaluation of journal articles, or simply clinical learning points the author has encountered which they can share

feeds.title: I used to be disgusted, now I try to be amused
feeds.description: Alarmed to discover he is now considered middle aged, a burned out cynical male anaesthesiologist ( and physician) expounds on life, medicine and anaesthesiology.

feeds.title: The Lay Medical Man
feeds.description: An anesthesiologist is a person, standing at the interface of medical and surgical specialties. He may cease to be an expert outside his field; but still possess a bird's eye view of most specialties. So I would like to label him as a 'layman' among the various specialists, who can save lives.

feeds.title: Allegheny Anesthetists Blog
feeds.description: For more than 25 years, Allegheny Anesthetists has enabled motivated CRNAs to grow their career and maximize their potential by providing the opportunity for growth and independence. Our goal is to help you build your career into something better, based on your flexibility, preferences, and individual strengths.

feeds.title: Cardiac Anesthesiologist
feeds.description: Cardiac and General Anesthesiology News, Guidelines, Tips & Tricks.

feeds.title: Anesthesiology News
feeds.description: Anesthesiology News, now in its 43rd year, has been the best-read publication for the specialty for the last 20 years. Our news magazine offers extensive coverage of major scientific meetings affecting the specialty, feature articles on topics relevant to practicing anesthesiologists, in-depth clinical reviews written by thought leaders, practice management articles, medical education.
